mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market, which with falling industrial production (INDPRO) signals a deepening economic downturn causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS, HOUST, and INDPRO fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%), economic output contraction causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strengthening housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of months with a positive month-over-month change in RSAFS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) with falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicate severe labor market contraction, signaling a deep recession that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS, UNRATE, and INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and strong residential investment (RSAFS > 300000), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion phase, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
